title: Parameters for Speed Scale Estimator Module

update_interval.description: Timer interval for estimation updates in seconds. Unit is **[s]**.

max_pose_lag.description: Maximum allowed time difference between consecutive poses used for pose velocity. Samples exceeding this value reset the previous pose. Unit is **[s]**.

max_stamp_lag.description: Maximum allowed absolute timestamp difference between the current pose and the nearest IMU sample, and between each end of the pose interval and the nearest velocity report or NDT correction sample. Unit is **[s]**.

sensor_buffer_duration.description: Duration of the rolling buffer for IMU and velocity report messages used for timestamp synchronization. Must exceed `max_pose_lag` + `max_stamp_lag` so that the whole pose interval stays in the buffer. Unit is **[s]**.

initial_speed_scale_factor.description: Initial speed scale factor value used before estimation begins.

initial_speed_scale_factor_covariance.description: Initial covariance of the speed scale factor state (P).

process_noise_covariance.description: Process noise covariance of the speed scale factor state (Q).

measurement_noise_covariance.description: Measurement noise covariance used in the Kalman filter update (R).

max_angular_velocity.description: Maximum allowed IMU angular velocity in rad/s. Samples exceeding this value are filtered out to reject obvious curves and turns. Default 0.0105 rad/s (~0.6 deg/s) is chosen around the practical IMU bias/noise floor; tune per vehicle and operation (e.g. with IMU bias cancellation) if needed. Unit is **[rad/s]**.

max_speed.description: Maximum allowed pose velocity in m/s. Samples exceeding this value are filtered out to avoid extreme speeds that may cause inaccurate estimation. Unit is **[m/s]**.

min_speed.description: Minimum required pose velocity in m/s. Samples below this value are filtered out to ensure sufficient motion for reliable pose-differentiation-based estimation. Unit is **[m/s]**.

enable_ndt_stability_check.description: Whether to require NDT scan matching to be stable. When enabled, the node subscribes to the NDT initial-to-result relative pose and rejects samples whose correction is large or whose stamps do not cover the pose interval.

max_ndt_longitudinal_correction.description: Maximum allowed NDT correction along the predicted heading, i.e. the longitudinal component of the initial-to-result relative pose. This is the axis that degrades in degenerate environments and it directly corrupts the pose-differentiation velocity. Only used when `enable_ndt_stability_check` is true. Unit is **[m]**.

max_ndt_lateral_correction.description: Maximum allowed NDT correction perpendicular to the predicted heading, i.e. the lateral component of the initial-to-result relative pose. Only used when `enable_ndt_stability_check` is true. Unit is **[m]**.

enable_degenerate_environment_check.description: Whether to require the vehicle to be outside a degenerate environment. When enabled, the node subscribes to the environment id published by `environment_adaptor` and skips estimation when the id is not allowed or is unavailable. Disabled by default because `environment_adaptor` is not launched by default and the judgement relies on `degenerate_area` polygons being annotated in the lanelet2 map.

allowed_environment_ids.description: Environment ids for which estimation is allowed. With the default `environment_adaptor` configuration, 0 is a normal environment, 1 is a uniform road and 2 is a feature-poor road. Only used when `enable_degenerate_environment_check` is true.
